FCF.description: Enable future cost function (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled).

FPHA.description: FPHA mode: 0 (disabled), 1 (precomputed from OPER_FPHA.csv), or "computed" (compute from VHA geometry).

oneOf.description: compute from VHA geometry at runtime

TON_Residual.description: Enable thermal residual TON treatment (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled).

UCH.description: Enable hydro unit commitment (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled).

UCT.description: Enable thermal unit commitment (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled).

opcao_execucao.description: Execution mode: 1 for iterative (LP→MILP→LP-FIXED→LP-CMO), 2 for single MILP.
